reviews.snippet: We have stayed at this hotel every May for last 4 years unfortunately we can’t go this year as have booked a trip to Alaska . We will really miss it as it’s great in every way. Staff and facilities are amazing and located close to the town

We have being going to the Regency for many years. The experience at the hotel is very different from any other hotel in the world (we have stayed at many). The atmosphere created by the family who own the hotel and their staff is magical. Apart from excellent service, cleanliness, great pool, amazing views there is a caring friendly atmosphere that practically all their customers embrace. Some people do like to keep themselves to themselves and that is easy to do, however as most customers return year after year friendships are built which contribute to good fun and many laughs. |The family and staff go out of their way to make sure their customers needs are met and they are happy. |The hotel is not all glitz and glamour, it is homely and comfortable. |Amazing food is served using local and fresh produce from the family farm.|The best views are from the bar looking over Kalkan.|If I were to criticise I would say some of the rooms could do with a makeover.

I have travelled many places in the world and The Regency is like no other. It is a ‘magical’ place (as described by the majority of their customers). It is the staff that create the friendly fun atmosphere. The care and attention they show to all their customers is second to none. Nothing is too much bother and always achieved with calmness and a smile. After 13 years going there sometimes 3 times a year with different group of friends I have to keep going as those friends also want to go back!! We do go to other places but The Regency and Kalkan is always the best. Thank you for many great holidays.

Staying in the Eton Vila’s, great standard and exceptional appointed |However we had a complimentary sauna / Turkish hamman, the whole experience was disappointing and spoilt the trip so far for me, Sauna wasn’t on but would take 20mins, no hot water in the shower!!|Paid by card and couldn’t pay in Uk|Just a shambles

Awesome, awesome, awesome!||Second time here this year (our fourth visit overall) and I would always recommend to anyone. ||The accommodation, food, drink and facilities are fab.||However, what makes this such a lovely experience is the staff. Every single staff member is such a lovely human being. They work so hard to make a stay so special. ||Thanks to everyone at the Regency! If anyone there reads this, please know that every team member makes such a special contribution to the enjoyment of our holiday. ||We love being here and we will definitely make more visits here. ||Book early if you want to stay here!
Absolutely amazing go above and beyond

What can I say that hasn’t been said by others….fabulous one of the best holidays we have had in a while….the hotel ,the staff…everything about it …great breakfast lots of choice…eggs any which way…we can highly recommend the omelettes ….lunch time never seen a hotel pool bar/ restaurant used so much food a delight freshly made to order  evening first class food on the terrace restaurant with amazing views across Kalkan bay  we met and made some lovely friends and people return here year after year I can see why…..Laura the Simpson holiday rep. Is great she has lived in Kalkan for a long time so knows it well and helps with reservations etc….trip on the hotel Gullet is a must especially the evening trip…if we had one thing to say some of the hotel rooms need updating our room had very few plugs to use for phone charging…But if we had asked for an extension they would have got us one nothing is to much trouble….we loved it   A lovely hotel sat in fabulous mature gardens with amazing family and staff…..hope you have a nice restful  winter and maybe see you next year……😎  regards Chris & Dave..🇬🇧
